batch: T04 RD-Agent container route + agent call budget (EXEC13 / A41)

mechanism.interception: importlib meta-path loader wraps litellm.completion after litellm is imported
mechanism.reconciliation: attempt terminal state copies the runtime count into the V5 agent_budget table (monotonic max), so cancel/restart cannot hand budget back
mechanism.unit: one wrapped litellm.completion call (client-level retries inside that call are not split)
mechanism.upstream_changes: none — RD-Agent source is untouched; the hook is a standard interpreter hook

real_engine_run.upstream_result: RuntimeError: Failed to create chat completion after 10 retries
real_engine_run.interpretation: the loop made exactly 3 calls; every later call — including all of the backend's internal retries — was refused by the hook, so the budget was not overrun and the run ended instead of silently spending more

limits: platform-level RD-Agent admission is still refused by the mandatory memory limit (rdagent.limits: host LocalEnv, no container), so the enforcement was verified against the real engine's own call site rather than through a platform Attempt
embedding calls are deliberately not counted (EXEC13 defines the unit as generative calls)
denied calls are recorded once as blocked_at, not as individual events
conclusion: agent_max_calls is now enforced before the call is issued, with a durable, restart-safe count and no RD-Agent source modification. A41 still does not pass: the RD-Agent container route (memory hard limit) is the remaining item.

rdagent_container.scope: one container carries the whole attempt (driver + factor code)

platform_attempts.note: temporary policy value for the check; it was restored to 200 right after
